description:
Create a recurring invoice series on PayPal.

This function creates a recurring invoice series that automatically generates and sends invoices to a customer on a schedule, specifying a billing frequency, a start date, a currency code, a primary recipient, and line items for the series template.

primary_recipients and items use PayPal's real nested shape (billing_info/shipping_info for recipients; unit_amount/tax/discount for items); other fields use a simplified flat shape.

A newly created series is in DRAFT status and will not generate invoices until activated -- call activate_recurring_series with the returned series ID to activate it.

Checked by fizzl-paypal-guard before it runs: within the owner's limits; above them the owner approves or denies.

inputSchema.description: Simplified create-recurring-series request. The tool implementation builds PayPal's actual nested recurring-invoicing API request from these flat fields.

allow_partial_payment.description: Whether each generated invoice allows a partial payment. If false, each invoice must be paid in full. If true, each invoice allows partial payments. Not available for users in India, Brazil, or Israel.

allow_tip.description: Whether the payer can add a tip when paying. Not available in Hong Kong, Taiwan, India, or Japan.

currency_code.description: Currency code of the recurring invoice series

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between each recurring invoice cycle. For example, an interval_count of 2 with interval_unit of MONTH means the invoice recurs every 2 months

interval_unit.description: The time unit for the recurring invoice cycle interval

invoicer_address_line_1.description: The first line of the invoicer's address, for example, number and street.

invoicer_address_line_2.description: The second line of the invoicer's address, for example, suite or apartment number.

invoicer_business_name.description: The business name of the invoicer.

invoicer_city.description: The city, town, or village of the invoicer's address.

invoicer_country_code.description: The two-character ISO 3166-1 country code of the invoicer's address (for example, US or GB).

invoicer_email_address.description: The email address of the invoicer.

invoicer_given_name.description: The first name of the invoicer.

invoicer_postal_code.description: The postal code of the invoicer's address.

invoicer_state.description: The state or province of the invoicer's address.

invoicer_surname.description: The last name of the invoicer.

items.description: The line items that will appear on each invoice in the recurring series

discount.description: The discount for this line item, subtracted from the item total.

amount.description: The discount as a fixed amount. Mutually exclusive with percent -- set only one.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

percent.description: The discount as a percent value, from 0 to 100. Supports up to five decimal places. Mutually exclusive with amount -- set only one.

item_date.description: The date, in yyyy-MM-DD format, when the item or service was provided.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item that the invoicer provides to the payer. Value is from -1000000 to 1000000. Supports up to five decimal places. Cast to string

name.description: The name of the tax applied on the item, for example 'Sales Tax'.

percent.description: The tax rate, as a percent value from 0 to 100. Supports up to five decimal places.

tax_note.description: A note about the tax, used to track tax-related data.

unit_amount.description: The unit price of the item. Does not include tax or discount.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

unit_of_measure.description: The unit of measure for the invoiced item

minimum_partial_payment_amount.description: The minimum amount allowed for a partial payment on each generated invoice, in the series' currency_code. Valid only when allow_partial_payment is true.

note.description: A note to the invoice recipient. Also appears on the invoice notification email.

primary_recipients.description: The primary recipient of the recurring invoices

billing_info.description: The billing information of the invoice recipient

additional_info.description: Any additional information about the recipient.

address.description: The address of the invoice recipient.

address_line_1.description: The first line of the address, for example, number and street.

address_line_2.description: The second line of the address, for example, suite or apartment number.

admin_area_1.description: The highest-level sub-division in a country, such as a state or province.

country_code.description: The two-character ISO 3166-1 country code (for example, US or GB).

postal_code.description: The postal code, which is the zip code or equivalent.

business_name.description: The business name of the invoice recipient.

language.description: The BCP-47 language tag used for the recipient's email notification (for example, 'en-US'). Only used when the recipient has no PayPal account.

given_name.description: The first name of the person.

surname.description: The last name of the person.

country_code.description: The country calling code, in E.164 format (for example, '1' for the United States).

national_number.description: The national number, in E.164 format.

shipping_info.description: The shipping information of the invoice recipient.

address_line_1.description: The first line of the address, for example, number and street.

address_line_2.description: The second line of the address, for example, suite or apartment number.

admin_area_1.description: The highest-level sub-division in a country, such as a state or province.

country_code.description: The two-character ISO 3166-1 country code (for example, US or GB).

postal_code.description: The postal code, which is the zip code or equivalent.

business_name.description: The business name for the shipping destination.

name.description: The name for the shipping destination.

given_name.description: The first name of the person.

surname.description: The last name of the person.

reference.description: A reference value, such as a purchase order number.

shipping_cost.description: The shipping cost for each generated invoice, in the series' currency_code.

start_series_date.description: The date when the recurring series begins and the first invoice is generated, in yyyy-MM-DD format. Cannot be a past date.

total_cycles.description: The total number of invoices to generate in the series. If omitted, the series runs indefinitely until cancelled.

name: create_recurring_series
